summary: Multi-company feature and Android safe-area/sticky-bar layout verified on mobile web viewport 390x844. All 9 requested checks pass. Created TEST_Alice employee, added 'Chantier Nord' via the centered dialog (company-name-input VISIBLE + editable), assigned it to today (Aug 2 2026) with 06:30 / 12:00-12:30 / 17:30 -> standard-total='10 h 30', decimal-total='10.50 h'; saved. Switched to another day in the same week (day-2026-07-29), created 'Chantier Sud' via the same flow, entered 08:00-16:00 and saved. On Récap: company filter chip row (company-filter-all, company-filter-<id> for both companies, company-filter-none) is rendered; filtering by 'Chantier Nord' reduces the Aug list to exactly 1 row with std/dec re-computed accordingly; company tag (briefcase + name) is shown on the entry row. export-pdf-button and export-csv-button do NOT crash on web (graceful summary-toast surfaces the underlying non-native error — same defensive shell as iteration_3). Regressions pass: theme-toggle-button toggles theme, month-prev/next-button navigates months, employee-selector-button picker works, data persists across reload within the same Playwright session. LAYOUT: tab bar (Saisie/Récap/Équipe) sits at the bottom with sticky Save / Export buttons just above it, no visual overlap, no huge empty gap. Only remaining console noise is the pre-existing 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' RN-Web warning (cosmetic, carryover). Deprecated packages: none detected.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — cosmetic carryover from iterations 1-3, non-blocking. Reference: unknown internal RN-Web component.

test_evidence.1_company_selector_on_saisie: PASS — company-selector-button visible above start-input/end-input; selected-company-name shows 'Aucune — appuyez pour choisir' when none selected.
test_evidence.2_add_company_dialog_visible_input: PASS — Tap open-add-company-button opens the CENTERED dialog; company-name-input is VISIBLE (assertion `page.is_visible('[data-testid="company-name-input"]')` returned True) and accepts typing; confirm-add-company-button creates the company, closes the sheet, and selected-company-name updates to 'Chantier Nord'.
test_evidence.3_picker_rows_exist: PASS — picker-company-none and picker-company-<id> rows render inside the bottom sheet; selecting either updates selected-company-name and closes the sheet.
test_evidence.4_time_calc_and_save: PASS — start-input=06:30, break-0-start=12:00, break-0-end=12:30, end-input=17:30 => standard-total='10 h 30', decimal-total='10.50 h'; save-entry-button persists the entry with companyId=Chantier Nord.
test_evidence.5_multi_company_different_day_same_week: PASS — Switched to day-2026-07-29 (Wed), created 'Chantier Sud', typed 08:00 / 16:00 and saved — two companies assigned to two different days in the same displayed week.
test_evidence.6_recap_filter_chips: PASS — company-filter-all, company-filter-<id> (2 chips, one per company), company-filter-none all render. Filtering by 'Chantier Nord' (Aug view) reduces summary rows from all-Aug to exactly 1; month-total-standard/month-total-decimal recompute (10 h 30 / 10.50 h).
test_evidence.7_company_tag_on_row: PASS — Each entry row that has companyId shows the briefcase icon + company name pill (Feather 'briefcase' + text 'Chantier Nord'). Verified via text count >= 2 across the two months.
test_evidence.8_export_no_crash: PASS — export-pdf-button and export-csv-button on web surface the summary-toast error string (native Print/File not implemented on web) without red-screen. This is the same defensive path validated in iteration_3.
test_evidence.9_regressions: PASS — theme-toggle-button toggles theme (sun<->moon), month-prev-button/month-next-button navigate to 'Juillet 2026'/'Août 2026', employee-selector-button opens picker, data persists across reload within the same session.
test_evidence.10_layout_bottom_bar: PASS — On 390x844 the 3-item tab bar (Saisie/Récap/Équipe) sits at the bottom; the sticky Save/Export buttons sit just above with a small gap (no overlap, no giant empty gap). Screenshots /tmp/04_saisie_after_2nd.png, /tmp/05_recap_all.png confirm.

action_items: None blocking. The multi-company feature and safe-area / sticky-bar layout are working as specified on mobile web preview.
STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: on a real Android device, verify insets.bottom > 0 actually pushes the tab bar above the system nav bar (cannot be simulated on web where insets.bottom is 0).
Optional cosmetic (carryover from prior iterations): silence 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: (tabs)/index.tsx: company picker + add-company centered dialog are implemented cleanly — KeyboardAvoidingView around the dialog + autoFocus on company-name-input + onSubmitEditing wiring make the flow keyboard-safe.

(tabs)/index.tsx: sticky saveBar uses `paddingBottom: spacing.md` (fixed) as advertised in the review request — no more variable insets.bottom in the sticky bar; combined with tab-bar `paddingBottom: insets.bottom` in (tabs)/_layout.tsx this cleanly separates system-nav padding from sticky-bar padding.
AppStore.tsx: addCompany / removeCompany are properly persisted (COMP_KEY), and removeCompany detaches companyId from any impacted entries (good referential integrity for a local-only store).

summary.tsx: company filter is memoized in `entries` useMemo with companyFilter in deps — correct; also correctly re-computes totalMin from filtered entries so month-total-standard/decimal always match the visible list.
summary.tsx: filter chip row is only rendered when `companies.length > 0` — matches the review-request UX (no filter UI when there are no companies).

Minor nit: (tabs)/index.tsx bottomPad uses `insets.bottom + 96` and saveBar has its own `paddingBottom: spacing.md` — works, but the two padding sources make it non-obvious how the sticky bar spacing composes. Consider a shared constant if the layout is tweaked further.
No new files exceed the 700-line threshold; no DRY violation introduced; no hardcoded URL/creds; env config untouched.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Alice + companies 'Chantier Nord' and 'Chantier Sud' + 2 entries (2026-08-02 Chantier Nord and 2026-07-29 Chantier Sud) via UI. LocalStorage-only. Note: Playwright launches isolated browser contexts, so this data does not survive across separate Playwright runs (already noted in iteration_3) — this is a testing-environment artifact, not a product bug.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-company flow verified end-to-end. Key testIDs: company-selector-button, selected-company-name, open-add-company-button, company-name-input, confirm-add-company-button, picker-company-none, picker-company-<id>, company-filter-all, company-filter-<id>, company-filter-none. Multi-company entries can span months; Récap month view scopes to the current month, so 'seeing all entries at once' requires navigating month-prev-button/month-next-button. Web preview: export-pdf/csv toast strings are expected internal errors (expo-print/expo-file-system not on web) — do not treat as bug. For safe-area on Android, must test on device.
